provenance.label: optimized candidate profile; single pass; instrumented/in-memory profile transform
provenance.candidateSource: src/experiments/konva-canvas/main.ts at measured worktree state; retained shadowForStrokeEnabled=false only when node count > 9
provenance.profileRunner: experiments/konva-browser/profile.mjs; executed as a temporary copy with only output and evidence destinations redirected to experiments/phase3/konva-browser
provenance.comparisonBaseline: experiments/konva-browser/profile-results.json at source baseline a07bb09; same in-memory plugin transform and scenarios
provenance.instrumentationValidation: Profile transform's source match guard completed for all 24 samples; all interactions verified; no browser errors

method.profiling: CDP V8 CPU sampling at 1ms; per-layer JS drawScene/drawHit wrapper timings; stage getIntersection wrapper; explicit source transform wraps updateWireGeometry and construction segments; visual screenshots excluded from numeric data and only saved on repeat 0 full mode.
method.nativeVsJs: Layer drawScene/drawHit durations are JS/Konva submission time. Native raster/compositor cost is separately represented only where present in V8 CPU profiles, which do not capture all GPU/native work; no raster time is inferred from JS method timings.
method.isolation: Transient Vite dev server bound to 127.0.0.1, source transform in memory only; no REST; no app/source/benchmark/results changes.
method.variants: nodes-only omits makeWire calls and adds zero wire shapes; wires-only omits makeCard calls and adds zero card groups. This is never-constructed, not hidden/visibility-disabled rendering.
method.probes: No forced GC or canvas pixel readback in measured windows. Screenshot capture occurs outside timed intervals. Browser CPU profiler is enabled for construction, gestures and hit query; interpret as instrumented profile data.
